claim: CSET (June 2022, citing Yole 2021) reported that 9 of the 10 largest OSAT firms by revenue were headquartered in mainland China (3), Taiwan (5) and Singapore (1).
evidence: "Today, 9 of the 10 largest OSAT firms by revenue are headquartered in mainland China (3), Taiwan (5), and Singapore (1)." (CSET, Re-Shoring Advanced Semiconductor Packaging, June 2022, printed p. 31; footnote 77: Kumar, Chitoraga, and Shoo, "Status of the Advanced Packaging Industry 2021," 70)
notes: The tenth firm is not named by CSET. Data vintage is c.2020; TrendForce's 2024 top 10 differs (no Singapore firm; includes Hana Micron, South Korea).
